definition.note: No chart is stored: the profile height is f(x) = a * integral of sinh(X^2/2a^2), not elementary; the builder integrates it by Simpson's rule. The shipped implementation is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
